Subject: Prep: Board update — action items & data asks

Team — attaching the current draft of the board packet (v0.3). High level ask: I need slide-level owners and the live data artifacts by end-of-day Tuesday so I can consolidate for exec review Wednesday. Specific asks below: 

- Slide owners: please confirm who will own each slide in the attached deck (use slide numbers).
- Data asks: revenue chart (monthly run rate + QTD), ARR waterfall, churn cohort table, ops cost breakout. If you own a number, attach the source CSV.
- OKR check: I added an OKR appendix (slides 30-33) — please validate statuses and short commentary (1-2 sentences each).
- Risk/Governance note: Neha, please include a one-slide summary of any open compliance items and mitigation timelines.

Timeline:
- Tue EOD (10/05): all data & slide edits in Drive
- Wed 9am: exec dry-run
- Thu 11am: final pack to board distribution list

Attachments: 2026-10-03_board_packet_draft_v0.3.pptx, Q3_OKR_tracking.csv

Thanks — will track ownership in the action matrix I start in the Drive link below.

Sofia Ivanova
VP, Strategy & Ops | Redwood Inference

Thanks — reading through v0.3. A couple of narrative suggestions: 
1) Move the "Business Momentum" slide up (currently slide 6) to be slide 3 — lead with product adoption metrics, then revenue.
2) On the revenue chart (slide 8), can Marcus provide a monthly MRR series through Sept plus QTD bookings? I need the growth curve to be consistent with the metrics in the investor one-pager.
3) Clarify the ask on the Ops slide to show the cost-per-inference trend (Q1–Q3) rather than raw GPU spend — that tells the story better.

I attached a quick revenue chart mock (rev_chart_Q3.xlsx) and put comments on slides 3, 6, 8 in the deck.

Jonas Weber
Head of Product | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

Thanks all — consolidated checklist below and the updated pack attached (2026-10-06_board_packet_v1.pptx). Please read notes carefully: 

Action matrix (owners & deadlines):
- Slide ownership: Marcus (8,14,21), Neha (12 + compliance appendix), Jonas (3,6 narrative), Lauren (slides 24–27 — customer stories & hiring ask).
- Data delivery: Marcus -> MRR + ops CSV by Tue 10/05 6pm (moved earlier per his note).
- OKR blurbs: Everyone owning an OKR slide, please add 1-sentence status + next milestone directly in the appendix. Deadline Tue EOD.
- Redlines and public vs. auditor appendices: Neha to provide redacted language by Mon 10/05 noon.

Distribution & next steps:
- Thu 10/07 11:00am PDT: exec dry-run (SaaS/Board packet focus). Calendar invite to follow.
- Thu 10/07 17:00pm PDT: final deck freeze for distribution to external board list on Fri morning.
